tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza shrī tsakra sam+bha rā ya/ 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma'i de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i man ngag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung la yar klung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin 'dir brjod par bya ste/ de yang de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i phyag len la/ mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ mchod gtor dang zhu 'bul sngon du 'gro ba'i mkha' spyod ma'i bdag mdun mchod gtor rnams tshang bar byas la/ tshogs la longs spyod gsung yang rjes la mdzad/ gnas ci bde bar tshon nag po'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang bas mi chung bar/ tha mar re khā dmar po zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su ya yo med pa'i sar sran ma bkas pa kha sbubs la bkab/ yang na tshon nag po phyur bus mtshan ma byed gsung*/ bla mas dang po slob mas ma mthong bar/ 'bud dung byi dor legs po byas pa rgyan med pa zhig pang bar gos kyi khud du tshags byas/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal byas la/ gang drin dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyi rjes la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgos su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa 'di zhes bya ba tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa las 'gal pa dang*/ byang sems kyi bslab pa las 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags zab mo'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ mchod gtor bsnyen bsgrub las g.yel ba la sogs pa sdig pa sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad mthol lo bshags so gnod ngo 'gyod do// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg cing*/

ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngam rje btsun mar gsal btab la/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos shing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la chos kyi dbyings phyag rgya chen po da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug la/ yid rtse gcig pa'i mos gus gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas slob ma du yod des maṇ+ḍal nag po la kha phyogs par lus gnad legs par bcas nas/ dbus kyi mtshan ma la mig mi btsum par 'bru tshugs su gtod du gzhug cing*/ da nga yis gdams ngag cig ston pa yin gyis khyed rnams ma yengs par gyis shig ces brjod pa lan lnga'i bar du bskyar gyin bya/ de'i bar la slob dpon yang lus gnad bcas la/ oṃ gsum ma shib bur lan gsum bzlas/ de nas glo bur du 'bud dung de maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su ma yo bar bzhag la/ rol mo dang gu gul gyi dud pa bya/ oṃ gsum ma bzla/ de nas ngo legs par sprod dgos pa las/ de ltar bla mas bstan pa'i brda gcig la rtogs pa gsum skye ste/ ma skyes pa'i dus/ skyes pa'i dus/ skyes nas zung du chud pa'i dus gsum mo// dang po ni dkar po ma mthong ba'i sngon rol gyi rtog pa dang*/ nga la ji lta bu zhig 'byung ngam snyam pa'i sems de gang nas kyang 'ongs pa ma yin pa'i phyir ma skyes te/ skye med ma skyes nam mkha' bzhin zhes bya'o// de nas dkar po mthong ba'i dus su dkar po'i rtog pa glo bur du skyes tsam na dkar po ma mthong ba'i gong nas skyes nas kyang med la/ da lta de mi 'gag par rtag tu gnas pa yang ma yin pas/ skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// zhes bya ba ste/

skye ba med pa de las dkar po skye zhing skye med du 'gag par 'gyur ro// dper na du ba ni me'i sngon rol nas grub pa yang ma yin zhing*/ me las ma gtogs pa'i glo bur du gzhan nas 'ongs pa yang ma yin la/ mi 'gag par gnas pa'ang ma yin/ ma yin kyang du ba ni me las byung zhing der 'gags pas du ba rtag tu me dang 'brel ba'o// de bzhin du dkar po la sogs pa'i rtog pa yang skye med las sngon rol du grub pa yang ma yin la/ mi 'gag par gnas pa yang ma yin te/ 'on kyang skye med las 'byung zhing der thim pas skye med dang rgyun du 'brel pa yin no// de nas dkar po la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa yang dkar po'i blo 'gags pa'i dus su/ 'gags pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// zhes bya ste/ thim pas thim pa btsal bas mi rnyed pa bzhin no// de la nam mkha' bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha' la thog mtha' dang skye 'gag med pa bzhin du sems la yang skye 'gag dang thog mtha' med de/ ma skyes pa'i dus ni skye ba yin la/ dkar po'i blo skyes pa'i dus su yang 'gro ba dang thim pa mi 'dug pas skye ba med pa nyid yin pas na/ chos thams cad ni skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu yin no zhes blo thag bcad la zung du 'jug pa'i ngang la blo ji tsam gnas tshad bzhag go /zhes brjod la dar cig blo gnas su gzhug de nas yang rol mo bya/ gu gul dud pas bdug oṃ gsum ma brjod do// rjes gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs bya/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang la/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod bsngo ba sogs bya zhing rjes bsdu'o// zhes rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyis chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa gsal bar bshad pa go bde bklag chog 'di yang*/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni o rgyan skyabs kyis bgyis pa 'dis sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams kyi bka' mi chad pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'di'i phyag len gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yan gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ de nas tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ yang na sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yang na 'phags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab rdo rje/ 'phags rgyal/ bla ma bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa/ yang na 'phags pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ de gnyis la 'jam skya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ yang na sa paṇa/ yar sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul gsum la/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seṅge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng rgyal/ mkhan chen rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam rgyal/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring*/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ dbang rab/ byams pa rab brtan/ snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga kun dga' don 'grub/ des bdag ā nan+da la'o// yang na sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ kor brag pa rin chen seṅge/ de las yar klung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyi gsan par bzhed/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas chos rje brag phug pa'i man ngag zab mo rtsis che shos gcig yin/ phyag len ma nor ba yin zhes nan tan du gsungs so/ zhes yar lung pa'i 'di'i yig cha las 'byung ngo*// shubhaṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ dbang sngon rdul brtsegs lhun po la// thun mtshams sprin gyis 'khyud pa lta'i// he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud de// dpa' mo mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i// gsang ba'i rig sngags oṃ gsum ma// btus nas byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul// tshad ldan gzhung bzhin brjod par bya// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs sngags oṃ gsum ma btus nas byin rlabs bya tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/

dngos gzhi/ mjug chog go /dang po la gnyis/ slob dpon gyis bya ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis gnas khang bdud rtsis byugs pa la me tog gi sil ma bkram/ rdo dril/ cang te'u/ las bum/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gtor ma/ tshogs rdzas/ bgegs sbyong gi chas/ 'thor 'bru sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad spyi dang*/ khyad par ras sogs 'bri gzhi gtsang ma la/ phag mo gzhung drug gi nang tshan ri khrod dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i zhal gnyis ma chung ba'i sgrub thabs las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// gsang sngags btu ba'i cho ga mchog /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar// rdo rje rol pa las byung ba// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bshad cing*// btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang ngo*// ā li kā li'i dbye bas der// sde tshan brgyad kyi rim pa ni// gzu

1 gas me 3 mad 5 'a dang thu 7 ba pa dang*// bu 9 ga pa dra 11 ga po 'dod pa nyid 13 // re mig rnams la rim bzhin du// man ngag gis ni dgod par bya// dang po a yig nas brtsams te// yi ge ha yi mthar thug par// g.yon skor gyis ni sbyor ba yis// bde mchog rgya mtshor gsungs bzhin bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du re'u mig zhe dgu byas pa la/ k+ṣa yig ma gtogs pa'i dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge zhe dgu dpe'u ris ltar bkod pa'i btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor stegs bu'i steng du bzhag pa'i mthar mchod pa g.yon skor du bsham/ rje btsun ma'i mngon rtogs bsgom/ bsang chu sgrub/ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma la khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal bgegs sbyong chos bshad ci rigs kyi rjes su/ dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// rig sngags bla na med pa'i gsung*// bklags pas don kun 'grub byed pa// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa 'bog go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ sngags btu gzhi las ji ltar btu ba/ sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul lo// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis gzhung tshig rnams dag par bklags pa'i brjod don dang mthun par/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus long dri bzang gis byugs pa la/ sin+dhu ra/ gur gum/ gi waṃ/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams mtshal dang bsres pa'i snag tsha dang*/ gser ram mi rus sogs kyi smyu gus/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dang*/ nang gi dbus su bam̐ yig de'i mdun nas g.yon skor du oṃ gsum ma dbu phyir bstan phreng gcig la snyoms par 'bri'o// gzhung tshig ni/

oṃ tha steng oṃ sum 'gyur byas nas ni// thigaṃ le nā das rnam par brgyan// bha steng sa tsha ba steng yi ge nyid// ṭa yi steng ra mas spyi bor brgyan// tsa ba ba 'i dbus nas blangs nas ni// ḍā yi 'og ma u sa 'og tu brgyan// shra da steng sha log steng dha ma ni// de bzhin yang dag sbyar ba'o// l̥ thung 'og ḍa gi yi ge la// nya yi 'og ma ā sa rnam par brgyan// sa steng ka ta log 'og ma i sa brgyan// pha steng tha na log 'og ma e sa bcing*// ha ṭa'i dbus ga ya nas yi ge la// ṇa yi steng na gnas e pas brgyan// ṣa yi 'og na gan ba sa pa bzung*// bha 'og dza stan du ṇa 'og bya ra // ha yi steng ga wa nas yi ge nyid// ra yi steng ma ṇa nyis brtsegs la// ṭa yis steng ra ma spyi bor sbyar// pha yi steng na gan na sa pa la// ṭha yi 'og na ga i nas pas brgyan// nya steng ya ṇa steng gi e sa brgyan pa// man ngag bzhin du shes par bya// tsa ba'i ba ba ra na gnas pa blangs// bha 'og dza steng du ṇa 'og ra sbyar// de bzhin tsha yi steng ma ba blangs// ta yi steng na gan ai sa pas brgyan// ṇa yi 'og ma ra tha steng o sbyar// pha yi 'og na gan tsa sa pa blangs// dha pa'i dbus gan na sa yi ge la// ṭha yi 'og ma i sa rnam par brgyan// nya la'i dbus gnas ya yi ge la// ṇa yi steng ye mas brgyan par bya// wa ma'i dbus ga ba nas yi ge la// ṛ ring 'og ma la gdags par bya// thigaṃ le nā da ྃ yang dag ldan// sum 'gyur du ni bya ba yin// na 'og pha ra yi 'og ṭa mas dbye// snga ma bzhin du sum 'gyur bya// sha yi 'o sa ga ma tha 'o wa ga zha 'a ོna// nya yi 'og na a gnas pa sbyar// wa 'a ma'i bar na gan ha sa pa bzung*// dzha yi mdun gyi da ā byangs kyis brgyan// bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni// gsang sngags btu ba'ang shes par bya// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ btus pa'i sngags 'khor de btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañji btsugs pa'i khar bzhag la/

khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung dkyil zhes pa nas/ mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar bsgrub cing mchod/ de nas mtshams 'dir yig cha logs su gsal ba ltar tshogs 'khor sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya'o// gsum pa sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ slob ma rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams kyi go sar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob ma rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar lhar bskyed la/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma rje btsun mar gsal ba gsum ka'i thugs kar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor bar bla slob gnyis kas gsal btab ste/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug ste/ lan re re la mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gnyis thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad pa zhal nas thon/ slob ma rnams kyi kha nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags thams cad kyi byin rlabs thob par bsams la sum bsres byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma rnams kyis rang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs la/ nyi ma re re bzhin gzungs sngags chags med du bzla'o snyam pas lan bdun nam nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dam bca' dang mthun par bzla'o// de nas slob dpon gyis btu gzhi dang btus pa'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byug cing*/

slob ma rnams kyi spyi mgrin snying ga gsum du reg nas/ dbyangs gsal dang oṃ gsum ma brjod pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas dbyangs gsal dang oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru'i rnam par gnas gsum nas lus la zhugs pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum zlos la/ me tog bla ma la dbul/ bla mas de blangs te sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas nang mchod kyis btu gzhi dang btus pa'i yi ge rnams bkrus la/ bla ma rang gis kyang btung zhing lus la byug slob ma rnams kyi yang gnas gsum du byug cing*/ khyor bar byin pas 'thungs shing lus la byugs pas/ lus kyi cha shas rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// gsum pa mjug chog ni/ slob ma rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo zhes sogs go cha dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces sogs tshams rngam gyi sngags kyis bsrung ba byas la/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul rjes/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam dang*/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// zhes sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o// smras pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud kyi don// sha wa ri dang stong nyid ting nge 'dzin// bir+wa pa yi gzhung gis bkral ba gang*// sbas don kun gsal nyi mas phye mthong nas// a 'dus ka phreng ldan pa'i mtsho 'jing las// oṃ gsum rgyan mdzes gsang sngags nor bu'i phreng*// btus nas snod rung gdul bya'i mgul rgyan du// byin 'di khyo min skyes pas sbrum bzhin sba// 'di ltar bskyun las byung ba'i rnam dkar dges// phyi nang mkha' la spyod pa'i dpal thob nas// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i klong byings ma rgan 'gro'i// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen mchog tu bdag gyur cig

/ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig ces bya ba 'di ni bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi pa'i sngags btu dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i lung gsum gyi rjes gnang gi rgyun legs par thob pa'i ban+de dharmā bha dras sa skyong gi lor dngul chu'i ri phug tu sbyar ba'o// ༈ / dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang byed tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya'o// de la sbyor ba rten dang mchod gtor bshams pa/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa dngos bstan pa/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni gnas khang yid du 'ong bar bla ma yi dam chos srung gi rten dang*/ khyad par dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku gang 'byor bshams pa'i mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma rang rang gi phyag len bzhin dang*/ khyad par dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i gtor ma smad zlum po stod zur gsum mi rno ba la rtser nyi zla nor bu/ zur la me ri sogs rgyan ci mdzes mar gyis brgyan pa la/ mda' gtsang ma la dar dkar pos brgyan pa'i steng du dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sku tsa ka li rab gnas can btags pa/ gtor ma'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams bshams/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng du rdo dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod 'thor nas/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal me tog sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'dus bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa la gnyis kyi dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ bde mchog sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag skyed byas la yi dam gang dgos dang*/

gur zhal kyi rjes la/ dur khrod kyi bdag po 'di nyid kyi gtor ma/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtor chog bzhin phul/ gzhan yang las mgon sogs gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa rang gi phyag len bzhin phul tshar ba dang*/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ slob ma rab bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ de ltar min na bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar dbang thob pa bdun la sogs pa khrus byas/ nang du 'ong dus las kyi slob mas rol mo dang*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing*/ gong du bdag bskyed gang byas kyi rtsa sngags bzlas shing bgegs bskrad/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rje me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir chos skyong ba'i srung ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'di ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las/ dpal he ru ka sku skye ba med pa'i ngang la yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas te dur khrod chen po'i gnas na dngos grub 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad brgyal bar gyur to// brgyal ba sangs pa dang*/ 'khor de rnams kyi nang nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po stan las langs te/

dpal chen he ru ka la 'di skad ces gsol pa/ kye/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru ka /bskal pa snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gdug pa can rnams 'khrugs pa dang*// sa bdag klu gnyan nad yams dar// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i tshe// mi rnams bsod nams longs spyod chung*// rang bsags dngos po spyad dbang med// pha dang bu bral longs spyod nyams// de dus bcom ldan bstan pa 'di// dpa' bo bdag gis bsrung bar bya// zhes gsol pa dang*/ dpal chen ha ru kas/ legs pa dur khrod bdag po khyod// srog gi snying po bdag la phul// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tad+yā tha/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum thi swā hā/ zhes ldong gsos dang bcas te srog gi snying po phul zhing*/ dam la btags pa'i srung ma'i dbang po khyad par can/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ dus khyad par can bcu bzhi rnam pa gnyis sam/ brgyad gnyis gang rung ba la bya dgos shing*/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba yi dam lha'i bdag bskyed/ yi dam chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba dang khyad par dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum la mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs phyag len bzhin legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dur khrod bdag po gnyis su ma mchis pa la/ rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis// byin gyis rlabs pa stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar brjod/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dhā+o3haṃ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang 'gron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa sogs gtor chog ltar skyed/ slar slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes chags kyis mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum kyi sku dpag tu med par gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pa la brten nas sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ dril bu sogs rol mo bya/

oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum thi swā hā/ pra be sha ya hūm̐/ a be sha ya a/ zhes mang du bzlas so// des sku'i rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i byin rlabs dang*/ nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi gsung gi rang bzhin rtsa sngags yig 'bru'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyis mes 'od du zhu sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa las yi ge ā li kā li dang*/ yab yum gyi sngags dpag tu med par gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas sib sib thim pa la brten nas gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs par mos mdzod/ ces brjod sngags dang rol mo bdug pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung gi don du/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dang*/ slob dpon gnyis ka dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du am̐/ sa bon gnyis kyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor nas yod par mos/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/

khyed rang rnams dur khrod bdag po yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dang pos thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza nas swā hā'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis rlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ slob ma rnams la me tog gtor/ de rnams kyis gsung gi rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su ngag gi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/

slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa gri gug dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dbyug tho dang*/ thod pa dang*/ dgra s+t+wa la sogs pa dpag tu med par gyur te/ sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar mtho gang tsam du cung zad gnas te/ de ma thag thugs kar sib sib thim pa la brten nas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sngags dang rol mo bdug pa sogs 'dra/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su sems kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas srod yin na gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ nyin mo yin na spos reng btsugs la/ las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon gyi phyag tu gtor ma phul/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma 'di nyid khyod rang rnams kyi dbu thog tu bzhag pa la brten nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs de dag brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod ces byas la/ slob ma re re'i mgo thog tu 'jog pa dang*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ a/ hūm̐ a tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pa dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo bdug pa gong bzhin bya/ thams cad la tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma sngar shul du bzhag mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsos la sbyangs/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ bdag cag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces phrin las bcol/ slar gtor ma slob dpon gyis bzung la dpal 'bar sogs gong bzhin/ de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

gtor ma 'di nyid dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum du gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs pa yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung ba zhig byas pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgo zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ ra hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dz+nya na sengha/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na/ dpal chen dga' lo/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seṅge bzang po/ yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis pa la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ skyabs pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig khyad par sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las gang bcol ba thams cad 'bad med du bsgrub pa dang*/ dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo zhing phrin las sgrub par bsam la gtor ma slob ma rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag cing*/ slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis rlabs kyis/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod/ rol mo bdug pa gong bzhin bya/ thams cad kyi mgo thog tu gtaur ma bzhag tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma dur khrod bdag po yab yum du gsal ba 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs snying kha'i sa bon la thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs mi 'bral bar dbyer med du byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di rnams kyi sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zab mo thob pas de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi 'gro/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong*/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni thun gtor 'bul dgos na phul/ de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa la rten bzhugs med pa la bshegs gsol/ gur lha brgyad kyi sku med na lha brgyad rang gi snying gar bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung ba go bgos sogs bdag skyed dang bstun la bya/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di/ rang gi dran pa gso ba dang*/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po spun dang*/ chos tshul 'di la dad pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun phyag len gyis brgyan te/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod dang ldan pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor ba chen po/
maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
